entry.title: DREAMFIT · NATURAL TEXTURES
entry.summary: Proyecto por Alex G. // CranioDsgn con 10 imágenes.
entry.content:
Autor(es): Alex G. // CranioDsgn

DREAMFIT · Natural Textures

This project was born from the exploration of different textures found in nature, from plants and leaves to ice, stones, and minerals, transforming them into a visual language designed for the interior spaces of DREAMFIT training centers.
Using photographs and natural references, I developed a series of illustrations that reinterpret these textures through a graphic and contemporary approach, enhancing their shapes, volumes, and patterns.

The goal was to create visually striking compositions that would bring personality to the walls of DREAMFIT centers, creating a dynamic and energetic environment while maintaining a connection with the organic forms found in nature. The result is a collection of pieces that combines nature, texture, abstraction, and graphic design, adapted to large formats to integrate seamlessly into different areas of the training centers.
